mapper.sql: i.order_id, i.user_id, u.name AS username, s.service_name, s.service_describe, s.campus AS campus, i.reason, i.create_time, i.update_time, i.manage_status, c.name AS consultantName, i.slot_date AS slotDate, i.start_time AS startTime, i.end_time AS endTime, e.name AS equipmentName, i.quantity AS quantity, r.name AS roomName

FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id LEFT JOIN consultant c ON i.consultant_id = c.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON i.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN room r ON i.room_id = r.id
mapper.select: SELECT u.email FROM item i JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT s.service_id, s.service_name, s.service_describe, s.service_state FROM item i JOIN services s ON i.service_id = s.service_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE services SET booked_count = booked_count + 1 WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} AND (capacity = -1 OR booked_count < capacity)

UPDATE services s INNER JOIN item i ON i.service_id = s.service_id SET s.booked_count = GREATEST(s.booked_count - 1, 0) WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.consultant_id IS NULL AND i.slot_id IS NULL AND i.room_id IS NULL AND i.equipment_id IS NULL
UPDATE time_slot t INNER JOIN item i ON i.slot_id = t.id SET t.available = 1 WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.consultant_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE item i JOIN services s ON s.service_id = i.service_id SET i.manage_status = #{completedCode},
s.booked_count = CASE WHEN i.consultant_id IS NULL AND i.room_id IS NULL AND i.equipment_id IS NULL THEN GREATEST(s.booked_count - 1, 0) ELSE s.booked_count END WHERE i.manage_status = #{approvedCode} AND ( (i.end_time IS NOT NULL AND (i.slot_date < CURDATE() OR (i.slot_date = CURDATE() AND i.end_time < DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%H:%i')))) OR (i.end_time IS NULL AND s.end_date IS NOT NULL AND s.end_date < CURDATE()) )
